prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, census item 2 (bin proofs): a bare subprocess argv beginning with the word bash resolves through CreateProcess to C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe, the WSL launcher; and a direct exec of the shebang script bin/cairn raises WinError 193. Sites measured by grep and AST: bin/proofs/test_a_declared_instance_is_wired_by_the_command.py:76 (bare bash), test_logger_for_bash.py lines 67, 279, 378 (bare bash -c and --rcfile), test_proof_gate.py:230 (bare bash -c), and test_a_word_with_no_script_goes_onto_the_bus.py lines 75 and 106 (str(CAIRN) exec, which every one of its teeth rides). The other bin proofs already use shutil.which('bash') or bash_script_argv.
